json_ld.description: Our NEW shoe charms offer an effortless way to personalize your huarache sandals—no commitment required. Equally suited for sun-soaked weekends, destination escapes, or evening moments, they bring versatility with a quietly luxurious edge. Mix, layer, or interchange charms to mirror your mood, your look, or the season.
